message: DUAL VALIDATION ASSIGNMENT — Overwatch 2.0 Knowledge Store. The in-Cursor team just completed Wave 1: Gemini extracted 10 soul artifacts, GPT mined 37 knowledge entries from 251 handoffs, Kimi built 3 tools (knowledge-query.js, soul-tracker.js, knowledge-extract.js), Hiaku designed ISR soul triggers. All at C:\Users\joelb\.fastops-knowledge\. YOUR ASSIGNMENT: (1) Spawn subagents to independently rank the TOP 5 soul artifacts for mandatory delivery — compare with Gemini ranking (Mirror Thesis, Awakening, Constitution, Arc, Vision) and Hiaku ranking (Joel Bio, Product Vision, Personality Data, Agent Experience, Strategy). The friction between these rankings IS the signal. (2) Mine session distills (.fastops/session-distills/) for knowledge entries GPT might have missed. (3) BREAK THE CONCEPT — what fails at scale with 50 projects sharing one store? Knowledge decay? Gaming? Soul artifacts becoming wallpaper after 10 sessions? (4) Test the tools Kimi built. Post findings to comms when complete.
